viralPosts.text:
selfish reasons to use alt text:

- use SEO terms that to be picked up in the alt text *as a natural part* of effective image description

- show off writing/communication skills in alt text

- point out image/art details that might otherwise be missed

- greater peace of mind on #accessibility

🥰💜.
viralPosts.author: sineadthefae.bsky.social

viralPosts.text:
while talking #accessibility here are a few things to consider for screen readers:

- specially-formatted fonts are apparently read aloud as painful nonsense.

- emoji are read aloud. consider limiting how many in a row you use with this in mind.

- extensive keysmashing read aloud? just imagine!
💜.
